notes.title: Crafting Menu Hotfix
notes.content: [p]If you have been running into gremlins getting in your crafting stations, outputting items that you did not specify, we have resolved the issue. This issue was specifically happening after long scrolls in the crafting menus.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to the folks that helped us track this down![/p]

tags.bug: If you have been running into gremlins getting in your crafting stations, outputting items that you did not specify, we have resolved the issue.

notes.title: Weekly Update!
notes.content: [p]Lots of feedback rolled into this week's build. More eye-catching UI. New ways to cultivate seeds and saplings. Your deeds and cashmoney (and crafting station progress) are now saved in [i]A Place to Call Home[/i]. All good stuff. [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Item tooltips now show how many of that item you have, in parenthesis after the name, if you have more than zero[/p][/*][*][p]Item tooltips now show the item size on the right edge of the subheader[/p][/*][*][p]Arts: mines, locked plots, cultivators, and bill coin added[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting job state from the 'A Place to Call Home' level is now persistent; If you leave while a job was counting down, it will still be counting down when you return[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with the Cruft Tally being incorrect when loading a level that had cruft already on the ground, such as the persistent yard[/p][/*][*][p]When you level up, the xp bar turns into a button that allows you to collect your deeds.,[/p][/*][*][p]The old popup that appeared when you level up has been removed[/p][/*][*][p]When your Cashmoney, Deeds, or Cruft tallies change, the numbers pulse a little and tick towards the new value[/p][/*][*][p]The market and dump buttons have a new style to match the redesigned stat UI[/p][/*][*][p]Seed and Sapling Cultivators[/p][list][*][p]Can be built at the Drafting Table once you complete a new Cheevo[/p][/*][*][p]Each takes in grown items and outputs a lot of seeds/saplings appropriate to what went in[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Shops may now buy or sell or trade in deeds[/p][/*][*][p]To craft a recipe, you now have to have all the required ingredients in the same location as the station. This is a temporary fix for a bug while we work out a better solution[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks a bunch for playing and giving great feedback![/p]

tags.feature: Item tooltips now show how many of that item you have, in parenthesis after the name, if you have more than zero
Item tooltips now show the item size on the right edge of the subheader
Arts: mines, locked plots, cultivators, and bill coin added
Crafting job state from the 'A Place to Call Home' level is now persistent; If you leave while a job was counting down, it will still be counting down when you return

tags.bug: Fixed issues with the Cruft Tally being incorrect when loading a level that had cruft already on the ground, such as the persistent yard

tags.feature: When you level up, the xp bar turns into a button that allows you to collect your deeds.,

tags.bug: The old popup that appeared when you level up has been removed

tags.feature: When your Cashmoney, Deeds, or Cruft tallies change, the numbers pulse a little and tick towards the new value
The market and dump buttons have a new style to match the redesigned stat UI
Can be built at the Drafting Table once you complete a new Cheevo
Each takes in grown items and outputs a lot of seeds/saplings appropriate to what went in
Shops may now buy or sell or trade in deeds

tags.bug: To craft a recipe, you now have to have all the required ingredients in the same location as the station. This is a temporary fix for a bug while we work out a better solution

notes.title: Makeover Update!
notes.content: [p]Hey Gang![/p][p]Lots of new art in the game today. CRUFT is getting a bit of a makeover as our new artist jumps in and re-smiths many pixels. Here's a list of things in the new build:[/p][list][*][p]192 new sprites including tools, meat, furniture, some stalls and stations, food, cash, materials, metals, woods, drafting table, mills, shelves, water, trash, and more![/p][/*][*][p]Tile lines cleaned up[/p][/*][*][p]Updated backgrounds[/p][/*][*][p]A popup message warns you If you try to purchase an item while the yard is full[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a UI bug that was preventing station popovers from closing if your mouse was in a specific region below the popover[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks a bunch for playing! More to come soon![/p]

notes.title: Smol Update
notes.content:
[p]Just a few fixes and tweaks that were ready to head out [/p][p]- Fixed various issues with the main menu and transition scenes at 5120x1440[/p][p]- The calculations for max camera zoom level now consider the current aspect ratio and handle cases where the background isn't wide enough to show the whole yard from top to bottom[/p][p]- Show an alternate cursor image when mousing-over an item that does something when you right-click it (links, stations, and tools).[/p][p]- The tutorial now teaches camera control[/p][p]- The tutorial now covers clicking items to trigger tooltips[/p][p]- The tutorial no longer requires two milking repetitions.

Thanks a bunch folks![/p]

tags.bug: - Fixed various issues with the main menu and transition scenes at 5120x1440
- The calculations for max camera zoom level now consider the current aspect ratio and handle cases where the background isn't wide enough to show the whole yard from top to bottom

tags.feature: - Show an alternate cursor image when mousing-over an item that does something when you right-click it (links, stations, and tools).
- The tutorial now teaches camera control

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494294/1e828d302043b774f29ba3349996698758dbbd60.png[/img]
Lots of various tweaks, fixes, and improvements. As always, thanks for all the feedback =)
[list]
[*] Fixed bug preventing shop timers from starting when you complete the tutorial (again).
[*] Added an 's' to Shop refresh and Recipe time displays.
[*] The station menu now displays ingredient item quantities in red if you do not have the required amount of that item
[*] If your yard is full when you try to collect from a station, a popup message now provides that feedback (MrSlayer et. al.)
[*] Sourdough has an outline to make it more visible (ladyambir)
[*] Tim is a little more generous with animal feed, in case you make butter instead of cheese.
[*] Roasted tomatoes value doubled
[*] Screws are a bit tougher to make, more in line with nails
[*] Item sprites that are being dragged or otherwise animated now sort properly.
[*] Stations now feature a gear icon in their bottom-left corner
[*] She stuff flying out the van when you market/dump is now based on its content, and the items can rotate.
[*] When you trade an item to a contact, the item animates instead of just disappearing
[/list]

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Weekly Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494294/fba71689dc02d906fb842f8e88e6abc3b980da64.png[/img]
Hey Gang!

We're already getting tons of great feedback to work with. Next Fest has been a fun ride so far. Going into the weekend, we have some fixes and QoL changes for you!

[list]
[*] Pizza is worth more cash money. 10 :cash_money:  now. (Drekonka and LadyBugzy)
[*] Hats are now properly craftable at the Clothworks Stall (Austin Sanders)
[*] Station recipe entries should be clearer now (luna5745)
[*] Goose was being silly and acting like a 2x2 object. It now behaves like a 1x1 object (jaguarrl)
[*] Smithing Stall now has higher yield recipes with a chance to get some bonus output. (Drekonka)
[*] Tyrolean Hat removed from sewing machine and clothworks stall. (me)
[*] Panning for gold removed from mine. You do that in a stream, silly. (me)
[*] Crafting UI cleaned up to look a bit more clear on different resolutions (everyone)
[*] The volume of the background music can now be adjusted from the escape menu. (everyone who likes to party more quietly than me)
[*] The music in the main menu now respects your volume settings. (jaguarrl)
[*] The dump button will be disabled if there is no cruft in the van (HamsterPirate)
[*] Removed a tree recipe that had no asset. (me)
[/list]

Thanks a bunch for playing and keep the feedback rolling in. Y'all are the best!
mg

notes.title: Small Update!
notes.content:
Whew! What a ride it has been and here we are! Next Fest starts today and here are some fixes to make the demo experience even better. Enjoy![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494294/7dbe835f63dcccc0a65d714237c061a95d6fb7c7.png[/img]

[*] The main menu now has music
[*] Full pass on fonts and readability. Many elements should look clearer now. Various fixes to overrun strings..
[*] Tree recipes now require fertilizer
[*] Nail recipe outputs less nails
[*] Fixed bug that prevented new BG music from playing when the first song finished.
[*] When you level up, a chime sound effect now plays and some dope sprites fly up to celebrate!
[*] When you craft an item, a sound effect now plays
[*] Van now plays a vroom when it heads out and the animation has been updated.
[*] No more cruft on the ground when you first show up.
[*] Crafting now has a *tink tink* sound
[*] Updated grid color.
[*] The cruft tally should now be accurate, even when quitting and resuming a game.
[/list]

Some fixes and changes! As a heads up the game now runs only in full screen now. Need to see how that plays out.
[list]
[*] When you refresh a shop, its title text now updates properly
[*] Added logging around achievement init and save file loading
[*] fixed bug that broke the tutorial if you had not opened any shops between resuming the game and hitting the point where a new shop is unlocked
[*] Audio setting changes now persist across sessions
[*] Ensure that pending save actions are completed before shutting down the app
[*] Fixed bug that prevented shop timers from starting when you completed the tutorial
[*] After purchasing an item in the shop, the next item in the list will be automatically selected.
[*] Switched to fullscreen and updated yard background to accommodate the change.
[/list]


Thanks for playing!
